network_contract: No Internet. Localhost sockets use OS-assigned ephemeral ports only.
model_contract: ScriptedLlm only; no cloud or local generative model is invoked.

experiments.claim: Exact google-adk 2.4.0, mcp 1.28.1 and a2a-sdk 0.3.26 interpreter.

agents-cli 1.3.1 itself has no direct ADK dependency, but its generated ADK/A2A constraints exclude the exact 2.4/0.3 baseline; local latest admitting release 1.2.1 is installed and its scaffold imports under ADK 2.4.
Required installed Google Skills are version 1.2.1 and match recorded relative-path digests; agents-cli info has a known detector gap.
A custom BaseAgent runs as root through App and Runner.
A chat coordinator transfers to a specialist through transfer_to_agent.
AgentTool isolates its child session and forwards child state deltas to the parent.
SequentialAgent, ParallelAgent and bounded LoopAgent execute in 2.4 but emit deprecation guidance toward Workflow.
Already-parented children fail, while duplicate sibling names and post-construction cycles require an AF fail-closed guard.
Workflow is not BaseAgent; AgentTool's constructor annotation is not runtime-enforced, so AF rejects the composition before construction.
Task agents are rejected as static graph nodes and chat graph nodes are accepted only directly after START.
Static sequence, routed edge and DEFAULT route execute.
Ordinary multiple incoming edges execute once per trigger; explicit Join waits for all predecessors and executes once.
Context.run_node dynamic selection and a bounded routed static cycle execute.
An unmatched route without DEFAULT ends the branch without exception, requiring an AF typed-terminal/default guard.
Unreachable nodes and unconditional cycles fail graph validation.
Retry succeeds on the configured attempt, timeout raises NodeTimeoutError, and one parallel branch failure suppresses Join downstream.
A Workflow-fixed FunctionTool and an Agent-selected function both execute with structured arguments.
A local stdio MCP server is discovered, filtered to one exact tool, invoked and closed.
Tool confirmation pauses before side effect and resumes to one execution for one response.
Local Streamable HTTP and legacy SSE MCP servers are discovered, filtered, invoked, closed and process-bounded.
A local OpenAPI Tool executes against localhost and injects a synthetic API-key credential into the declared header.
Missing mandatory FunctionTool input returns a structured error response.
Unavailable stdio MCP server fails observably and cleanup remains bounded.
Replaying the same confirmation response repeats the side effect; durable idempotency is application-owned.
An unavailable local Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint fails observably within the configured ceiling.
A malformed OpenAPI JSON contract is rejected before tool execution.
Session, user, app and temp state scopes plus partial/final event commit behavior are reproduced.
Artifact versions, latest/specific/missing loads and local memory search execute.
Runner.rewind_async appends a rewind action and restores prior state.
Concurrent artifact saves append distinct versions but expose no compare-and-swap contract.
Plugin callbacks run before agent callbacks and plugin short-circuit skips the agent body.
Plugin tool-error recovery returns a typed fallback and commits callback state before downstream continuation.
RequestInput pauses and resumes through a matching adk_request_input FunctionResponse using the primitive {result: value} envelope.
Runner rejects a resume message that mixes text and FunctionResponse.
Python 2.4 has no public Runner cancellation API and EventsCompactionConfig is not a public google.adk.apps export.
An existing Workflow is nested and executed without copying its internals.
A local Agent is exposed with to_a2a and consumed over real localhost HTTP by RemoteA2aAgent(use_legacy=False).
Local A2A input-required is returned, answered on the same consumer session and reaches completed output.
Unavailable local A2A discovery produces an observable non-success event rather than semantic readiness.
ManagedAgent is cloud-backed and source rejects client/MCP tools; ambient cloud triggers remain excluded.
output_schema and ordinary tools coexist through the injected set_model_response tool.
Graph single_turn wrapper rejects malformed JSON client-side while root chat delegates response-schema enforcement to the model API.
Unsupported END, Runner.cancel_async and public EventsCompactionConfig imports are refused.
Coordinator invokes two specialist AgentTools and produces a deterministic aggregate.
Graph fan-out and Join feed a terminal consumer that reads both state and an artifact.
Bounded routed cycle pauses twice for Human Input and guards side effects per iteration.
Parent reuses a nested Workflow and converts local A2A unavailability into a typed observable fallback.
Dynamic node selection is normalized by a typed schema, checked by a deterministic guardrail and emitted as a terminal result.
Google adk-code says output_schema disables tools; exact 2.4 source/runtime proves SetModelResponseTool compatibility and narrows malformed-output behavior.
Prior AF card said ordinary multiple-incoming OR fires once; exact runtime proves one execution per trigger.
BaseAgent documentation requires unique names, but exact 2.4 construction only logs duplicate sibling names; AF adds deterministic rejection.
Resume guidance says tools are at-least-once; exact duplicate confirmation reproduces a second side effect and requires durable deduplication.
Prior AF card recorded mcp 1.29.0; exact environment is mcp 1.28.1 and its stdio, Streamable HTTP and SSE behavior are re-probed.
Docs describe cancellation/compaction, but Python 2.4 exposes no public cancel API and compaction config is private from google.adk.apps.
RequestInput primitive response is unwrapped only from the exact {result: value} envelope.
Template Workflow Agents remain executable but exact 2.4 marks them deprecated in favor of Workflow and notes the current sub-agent limitation.
Framework to_a2a accepts Workflow, while Agent Factory taxonomy deliberately forbids Workflow A2A binding/exposure.
Current generator fails closed on unsupported/stale Graph shapes and preserves selected context and exact bindings.
Exact signatures/source close optional transports, parallel worker, task dispatch, live Workflow and local adapter boundaries without cloud execution.
Managed Agent execution, Pub/Sub/Eventarc, deploy, publish, cloud observability, online tools and external Web calls are inventoried but not executed.
Local qwen3.6-small adapter call.
